item.title: Overview of Matthew Part 2 – Following the King to the Cross and the Crown 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # Imagine finally finding the king you have been waiting for. For years, people have spoken about him. They have longed for the day he would come, defeat his enemies, and establish a kingdom marked by justice, peace, and righteousness. When he finally arrives, he exceeds every expectation. His wisdom astonishes the crowds, his authority commands attention, and there is little doubt that he is the king everyone has been hoping for.

item.title: Overview of Matthew Part 1 - Recognizing the King (Matthew 1-16) 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # Imagine arriving in a country that has spent centuries waiting for a king. The stories are everywhere. Elderly parents tell them to their children. Teachers repeat them from ancient writings. Worshipers sing about them in their prayers. Long ago, God promised that one day He would send a ruler who would set everything right. He would defeat evil, rescue God’s people, and bring God’s blessing to the nations. But the years pass. Then the decades. Then the centuries. Empires rise and fall. Wars are fought. Generations are born and die. Some people still believe the promises. Others quietly wonder whether God has forgotten them.
